name: claude-statusbar
description: Two-line status bar: directory, git, PR, model, session, context and 5h/7d quotas. No network, no credentials.

SHOW_GIT_STATUS.title: Git status
SHOW_GIT_STATUS.description: Show * when dirty, ahead/behind arrows and the stash count

SHOW_PR.title: Pull request
SHOW_PR.description: Show the number and state of the open pull request

SHOW_SESSION_NAME.title: Session name
SHOW_SESSION_NAME.description: Show the session name set with /rename

SHOW_CONTEXT.title: Context
SHOW_CONTEXT.description: Show the percentage of context consumed

SHOW_CONTEXT_TOKENS.title: Context tokens
SHOW_CONTEXT_TOKENS.description: Show the token count next to the context percentage

SHOW_PROGRESS_BAR.title: Quota bar
SHOW_PROGRESS_BAR.description: Show the ten-block bar next to the quotas

RESET_COUNTDOWN.title: Reset as countdown
RESET_COUNTDOWN.description: On: time left (2h13). Off: absolute time or date
